layer_reason: Failure is not arithmetic or tiling: the SPLIT_QK applicability predicate at host metadata level (candidate.py:430-431) gates a compile-time branch whose K loads are deliberately unmasked. It tests the padded BLOCK_D==128 but not the true channel count D==128. BLOCK_D=next_power_of_2(D) is 128 for any D in 65..127, so such metadata passes the predicate, enters the split branch, and issues two unmasked 128-wide K loads that read channels D..127 beyond the real head width; MASK_KV is simultaneously true (D != BLOCK_D) and the V path references kv_mask, which is only defined inside the non-split MASK_KV branch, so the compile path is also ill-defined. The fix belongs in the same metadata predicate, not in the kernel body or tiling.
